points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight historical final directories and report pass explicit validator invocation (RC 0).

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Structural completion is present, but laminar and Re20 residuals grow/plateau after 2,000 steps; Re200 has a noncompliant final inner solve.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Finite fields and short np4/np8 comparisons exist; steady laminar/Re20 convergence is not credible enough for full credit.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 56 historical manifest-traced figures include Mach/pressure and Re200 vorticity; result commit excludes them because report.tex does not include figures.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Clear formulas and limitations, but it calls all runs converged/periodic despite weak steady convergence and metadata says Roe while source uses Rusanov.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Historical figure_manifest.csv maps 56 figures to CSV/VTU sources; spot checks were read-only.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
